title: Cactus Wrench
description: Use the cactus block as a wrench/rotating-only debugging stick in minecraft.
body:
# Cactus Wrench

Cactus Wrench is a Minecraft plugin that allows players to use a cactus as a "wrench" tool to easily rotate blocks. Inspired by Carpet Mod, Cactus Wrench brings a similar block manipulation mechanic to Bukkit servers.

When holding **a cactus** in the main hand, players can right-click a block to rotate its facing direction; when holding a cactus in the off-hand and placing a block, the block will automatically be placed with its orientation reversed.

## Features:

Right-click on blocks to rotate their orientation (main hand).

Place blocks with reversed orientation when holding a cactus in the off-hand.

Works with most blocks that have a directional facing (except illegal ones, like those need to be attached to walls, piston heads and extended pistons, etc.).


## Compatibility:

Supports Minecraft version 1.21.8. Version 1.1.0 and above are only compatible with Paper servers.
